data.gender_notes: Sams is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sams is derived from the Sanskrit word Samas, which means equal or balanced. It is a name that signifies the power of the sun and represents light, energy, and strength. In Hindu mythology, the sun god is believed to provide life and energy to all living beings. The name Sams carries the meaning “Sun, Light, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sams usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sams is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism, representing the divine power of the sun and the balance of the universe. It is a name that is often used for babies born under the Leo zodiac sign and is believed to bring good luck and success in life.
data.etymology: Sams belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Light, Power.”
